text: The Toronto Transit Commission (TTC), as the sole shareholder of Toronto Coach Terminal Inc. (TCTI), appoints the Chair of TCTI, or if an alternative is required, the Vice-Chair, as its proxy to vote 10,000 shares on its behalf at any Shareholders meeting held during the year 2026.
The TTC Board: 1. Approved the attached proxy to exercise the 10,000 TTC Shares in TCTI.
